lines.text: Sam drove three hours to a national park with her dog, Juniper.
At the trailhead, a sign: no pets on trails.
Most national parks allow dogs only on a few trails, roads and campgrounds.
Here's the fix. Check the park's pets page before you go.
National forests and many state parks allow leashed dogs on far more trails.
The next weekend, Juniper hit the trail.
Save this before your next dog hike.
